title: Mythology of the Oppressed
department: School of Languages, Literatures and Cultures
description:
Credit only granted for: SLLC280 or SLLC299J.
Formerly: SLLC299J. Does information drive human history? Mythological recurrences say much about cultures that had to adapt their world views while attempting to preserve them. This course examines the cognitive or social bases of mythology, to be pursued from insights in cultural and literary studies, linguistics, the cognitive sciences, paleo-anthropology, archeology, etc. The course is designed to help students think about complex problems from a humanistic perspective, making liberal use of the sciences.
